notes: Portfolio-optimization spec over a weight vector w across multiple assets, bound to a single AAPL 1d feed (their own metadata: requires_multi_asset=true, requires_external_data=true). Every free parameter of the objective '(r - I(t))^T w - lambda w^T Sigma w - Theta |w|^(3/2)' is unpinned: r 'can be calculated based on historical returns or a factor model', Sigma 'you can use a factor model', lambda and Theta are never given values, rebalancing is '(for example, daily or weekly)', and constraints are offered only as 'Examples of constraints'. Sizing = w*, which is uncomputable without those parameters. The task text is also truncated mid-sentence ('...insufficient liquidity, since for'), so the final filter rules are missing ('other'). No hardcoded price levels, so hardcoded_prices_meaningful is vacuously true. Faithful single-feed reductions (scalar w on AAPL) will still diverge on lambda/Theta/r/Sigma choices, so INDETERMINATE rather than DETERMINATE-EMPTY.
